title: Pet Search
description: The competition that says, “No matter how insignificant you are, your pet may be a star!” As chosen by the audience, the most talented pet wins $1,000.
quote: It can’t be easy teaching pigeons to tap dance.
altHero: host with a grumpy looking man with a grumpy little dog
alt1: host with a man in a green sweater with a similarly green bird hanging from his arm
alt2: man with glasses reveals five pigeons wearing shoes and top hats
alt3: a one-man-band dog playing multiple musical instruments
alt4: a man dressed as Elvis with a dancing cat and dog
